response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM telescope_counts), ranked AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_above_average FROM shares) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_above_average FROM ranked WHERE share_above_average > 0 ORDER BY share_above_average DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;
